summary: JD.com Q3 2026 revenue rose 3.5% YoY to CNY 310B, beating estimates, but EPS of $3.46 missed forecast of $3.55; shares fell 2.68% after-hours.
Non-GAAP net income surged 43.7% YoY to CNY 8.3B; JD Retail gross margin hit record 20.1%, marking 18th consecutive quarter of expansion.
Free cash flow jumped 48.8% to CNY 19B over 12 months; JD Logistics revenue grew 16.1% while new business losses narrowed 38.7% YoY.
Company targeting high single-digit operating margins for JD Retail; plans to significantly reduce food delivery investment in 2027 amid profitability push.
Management emphasized continued AI and automation investments; completed Ceconomy acquisition to expand European presence with supply chain synergies.
